run.objective: Implement TASK.md model discovery across the LLM client and CLI. Keep tests unchanged and satisfy the full suite.

tasks.title: Add model auto discovery to BonsaiLLM
tasks.description: Modify BonsaiLLM in bonsai_agent/llm.py to resolve the 'auto' model alias lazily by querying the local server's /v1/models endpoint before the first chat or tool request. Cache the resolved model ID for subsequent requests and preserve explicit model names unchanged. Raise a useful error if the server reports no models.
tasks.acceptance: BonsaiLLM accepts model='auto' and resolves it from /v1/models on first use, caches the result, and raises a clear error when no models are reported.

tasks.title: Set CLI default to --model auto
tasks.description: Update the CLI in bonsai_agent/cli.py to default the --model argument to 'auto' so model discovery is triggered by default when no explicit model is provided.
tasks.acceptance: Running the CLI without --model uses 'auto' and triggers model discovery via BonsaiLLM.

tasks.title: Verify full test suite passes
tasks.description: Run the complete test suite to confirm all existing and acceptance tests pass with the new model auto discovery behavior.
tasks.acceptance: All tests in tests/test_model_auto_acceptance.py, tests/test_core.py, and tests/test_v02.py pass without modification.
